caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, dark brown chest with a slightly domed lid that is partially open. The chest features a metal handle on top of the lid and appears to be made of a glossy or metallic material. The exterior of the lid and the upper edge of the chest are decorated with a floral and leaf motif, with large red flowers, green leaves, and yellow elements on a light blue background band encircling the chest. There is also a decorative scalloped yellow design immediately below the band of floral patterns. The overall background of the drawing is plain, with a light beige or off-white color, and the chest is centrally placed with visible shadows and minor distressed spots indicating wear on the chest’s surface. The drawing is signed at the lower right corner with text.
title: Toleware Document Box
